title: What Nobody Tells the Hand

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The broom has its instruction and goes around. The lip keeps its white and is called weather. What nobody tells the hand to do, the house keeps by leaving it undone.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the yards of Low Kiln, told at the going of the light in Smoke's third week

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of two hundred and sixty-one to two hundred and sixty-three days, six months and eighty-one to six months and eighty-three days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. The surgeon's register colours the noticing — the file turned out as instruments on a towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air; the body inventoried as a wound of crust, gap, frozen thread, cold and afterdrop in the order they arrive; the house's omissions read as a keeping made of not-doings and kept as a finding with no payer, not a lesson or a doctrine; the hand's six answerings kept as honest objects and never promoted into a reach, a hearing, a seventh, a payment, a held change, a key, a power or a rule — with no present-tense Chicago break and no tagged remembered line; the old life stays offstage, and there is no departure from his eyes, no Court, collector, Waiting Room or back-room interior, no seventh hearing, no tenth stopping before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, no sixth asking and no witness for the row question, no tenth record-first hand, no eighth green or eighth shape, no third gap, no fourth likeness made a cause, no name spoken over either sighting, no sale, no calling of the loan, no naming of a payer, no private record opened, read or copied, no figure given for the covered grain or for the hand that did not come back, no lesson made of the one opening before Smoke 1, no third Account-day brought early, and no ending.

scenes.title: The Twenty-Second Morning
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, first dated \daymark (Smoke 22, Secondday, Y.H. 813) and the chapter's only drop cap on the opening words: small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof, then before first grey at the hearth, the kiln mouth, the drying racks, the cool stone at the rack end and the loaf shelf. Open with the hand laid down against the fold on the ninety-sixth answer; set it down like a tool put away where the next hand will find it without looking, never recalled as a sign, growth, reaching, gift or power. Count carried at 260 exact, six months and eighty days, told by nobody, coming into 261 at six months and eighty-one days (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and sixty-one days, its payer unnamed (T088). First smell hot clay under tallow, wet wool under that, sour Ash breath of the unswept corner called the thaw; first sound the kiln drawing in fours with a gap, not a bell. Three counts in three places — the kiln's four low pulls and silence under the floor, the river's water over water through the finger's-width door, the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot — none rising into another, for agreeing any two would want a payer and none stands (T061/T082). Body inventory in the old order: one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread frozen and unwiped; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform; he knows the severe face cold wears and wants the crust, both true and the second louder, entered nowhere (T060/T086). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells it the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it where another woman would say I, counts under her breath toward no opening, pushes coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak shows pale, glances once at the clay jar and shuts her hand half over nothing, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, moves her lips along a two-gapped row without giving either gap a figure, and sets the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand, a half-beat at the setting and no look toward the bed (T058/T079, T100). The dressed grain lies covered under wool on the cool stone at the rack end; she lifts a corner for damp and lays it back with no figure, so the arithmetic that will be read over it on Smoke 30 still will not know what it cost (T077). A thin white edge of frost has come on the north stone lip of the well; the bucket knocks it grey and the yard calls it weather, and he keeps the white on a place of its own with no cause, not a payer, not the widow's mark, not the first firing of Frost (T083/T085 carried). A cost-question goes to the pot and a man brings a number up out of a fist toward the well, looks at it and puts it back in his sleeve, so the figure arrives nowhere (T015/T041/T047, T077). Smoke 30 (Day 269) stands six mornings ahead and is not brought early; no market, Cross or bell in these three days. Hand answer ninety-seven: up an inch toward the low note, held for the small intake only, down before the letting-go, borrowing no house count. An object on the sixth place, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air.

scenes.title: The Places Left Undone
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 261, no new dated heading: afternoon thinning into the small hours at the Clay Yard's walked-around places, the yard well and bare trough, the drying racks and the space under the lowest rack, the pan's gone ring, the terrace and worked strips, the kindling and flagstones, the edge of the Vail wheel-shed, the finger's-width-open back room as a direction and a sound only, the clay road at the going of the light, the bed and the towel. Afternoon thins without ending; heat settles into the fold; one crust two inches off with its gap unnamed and no third; thread frozen; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint; afterdrop waiting (T061/T082). Garl is kept in objects, a keeping and not a story, his name unspoken two hundred and sixty-one days — salt-stiff coat with the left-shoulder crease, hollow wheel-seat, the proverb gone to a pot with no crack, the tile debt circled without a name, neither paid nor settled nor done with; no collector comes up or goes down the clay road (T009/T013/T092). Sella carries the basket at the half-pace from every open slate and goes wide around seven things, each with a look and a wide step and no number: the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the pan's gone round ring, the bare dark trough with its water called weather, the field's empty place out on the worked strips, and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, not paid). At the kindling Tarn takes the broom only after its instruction, says Yes, house to an early thaw and a late and keeps the late because it puts off the paying, tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, sets six in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip where it cannot, and keeps Garl's unforged collector sentence beside the knife with no name on the man and no figure on the debt. The ear-sentence comes to the word that would call the loan and stops there — a remembered ninth stopping, no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven (T036/T076). The Seed 16 breath is drawn at the top of the reach and not spent; chest tight; Ash worked into the knuckle creases in the colour of the clean dark line; the pale clip-ring at the left wrist holding what light there is; the warm stone cold and unreconciled in its unmarked loft pot; the stroke over the bright patch and the collector road without the half-check or a turn of the head (T006). At the wheel-shed edge Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent little finger and white in the creases of a fist, parts dusty forearms from clean ones and asks neither which slate broke nor whether it was a birth-slate; men unnamed went low into the back room before first grey and he gives the house no name for them and does not say the room was cold, the room's sound arriving at the basket as a direction (T035/T031). He speaks to the wheel before any person, tells a pot You'll do, knows its full note three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it and withholds the knowing on the near-full tray beside the hearings and never among them; the three pot sayings stay three with the premature Smoke 14 note on its own place and no fourth likeness made a cause (T061/T082). The burned-slate word stands at four from Slate Row and the two shut-room tellings at two; the promise of the boy's name is neither given nor withdrawn and he's not Vail stays sealed; when Sella's sentence goes low the bent finger goes into the cold damper ahead of it and holds until the end arrives at the pot (T062, T065/T095). Under the roof she sets him on the bed and not in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face, leaves the thread frozen, tells the fire the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it, counts under her breath toward no opening and goes to her own bed; the widow's mark hangs where it hangs and the one opening before Smoke 1 stays behind the household with no lesson, no mending, no sign and no payer named (T058/T079). In the small hours he turns the file out on the towel and finds it exact, complete and worth nothing: six hearings beside and never among with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place; three near-full answers; three pot sayings with the premature note apart; four low things with water over water a fifth; told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid with Smoke's second arithmetic locked up the road and unread; nine stoppings with no tenth; three held changes plus the loft scrape and the pale line on five places and the held inch on a sixth; nine record-first hands with Ilva's ninth on its own tray and her strip unread in her sleeve; the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth; the covered grain unfigured; the pan's ring and the other absences on trays that do not touch; the ownerless question at five askings with no witness and no row named (T071/T072, T080 held at nine, T101 held at five). Hand answer ninety-eight: up an inch, held through one whole interval of the river's own going, down on the river's next low note, borrowing no house count. An object among objects.

scenes.title: The Keeping Made of Not-Doings
scenes.synopsis: Third entry, third dated \daymark: Day 262, Smoke 23, Thirdday, Y.H. 813, from the small hours under the Vail roof up the Clay Yard to the drying racks, the rack end and the yard well, and back at the going of the light. New day, new date, no recap: 262 exact, six months and eighty-two days, nobody told (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and sixty-two days, its payer unnamed (T088); the widow's mark untouched since before the kiln on Smoke 1, because a yard, a rack, a well and a bed are not openings (T058/T079). Smoke 23 comes on its own morning, earned by that light, and was not brought into Day 261; no market, Cross or bell. Sella's grammar holds exactly — fire before basket, thaw told to the coals, broken pot turning them, The house will keep it, half-pace from every open slate, finger above the charcoal, pot handle two inches out, fold put right without a look at his face, thread left frozen. The chapter's one meaningful change is small and interior: through the morning's ordinary work the boy registers that the house keeps itself by not-doings — the two lines in the corner not swept, the widow's mark not touched, the charcoal not read, the fifth pull not supplied, the loan not called, no number spoken over him, the crust not lifted — and he keeps the seeing as a finding with no payer, not a grievance, a lesson or a doctrine, and does not lay the house's omissions across his own kept gaps, for a joining would want a payer and none stands (T071/T072, T009/T013/T092, T061/T082). The dressed grain is lifted at a corner for damp under the wool on the cool stone at the rack end and laid back with no figure (T077). At the yard well Ilva is glimpsed once, drawing with the pail against her knee, clay pale in her nail crescents and grey rack dust in the seam of one thumb; asked what the firings of Smoke have cost she keeps her hand in her sleeve, the notched birch strip not taken out, read, asked about or joined to the reed-cutter's cord, and answers the question put and not the one behind it — Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account — and goes on with her water while nobody turns twice (T080 held at nine, no tenth hand). A neighbour with a pot puts a cost-question to the pot and goes off level; a man come down the clay road brings a number up out of a fist toward the well, looks at it and puts it back in his sleeve, so the figure arrives nowhere and none is supplied (T015/T041/T047, T077). The frost's white edge on the well lip has gone grey under the bucket and the yard calls the whole of it weather; he keeps the white on a place of its own with no cause (T083/T085 carried). Hand answer ninety-nine: up an inch toward the low note and down before the letting-go of a borrowed count from the room that does not touch, borrowing no stroke and filling nothing. An object on the sixth place.

scenes.title: Two Places That Do Not Touch
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry of Day 262, no new dated heading: afternoon thinning into the small hours at the walked-around places, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the back room as a direction, the bed and the towel. Smoke goes on without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two names for the months is set right or left wrong. Afternoon thins like heat out of a pot set off the coals; one crust two inches off, its gap unnamed and no third; thread frozen; cold at cheek, temple and wrist; afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform (T061/T082). The seven walked-around places are gone around again with a look and a wide step and no number, including the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, carried and not named (T009/T013/T092, T098). At the kindling Tarn's knife lies at the very lip with six checkable and the seventh not, the unforged sentence beside it, the ear-sentence brought to the calling word and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled; the warm stone lies cold in its loft pot and not trying is not forgiving (T036/T076, T006). At the wheel-shed edge Jorra's meal-fine dust and the bent finger in the cold damper go as before, the burned slate at four and the two shut-room tellings at two, the pot's note withheld, he's not Vail sealed and the promise ungiven (T035/T031, T062, T065/T095). The boy holds the house's omissions on one place and his own kept empty intervals on another with a finger between them; the finding that a not-doing keeps as surely as a doing is entered nowhere, and the absence of a joining is itself kept, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stands (T071/T072, T061/T082). In the small hours the file is turned out and checked and found exact, complete and worth nothing: six hearings with no seventh, three near-full answers, three pot sayings with the premature note apart, told bell beside heard, told figure beside paid with Smoke's second arithmetic up the road and unread under this roof, nine stoppings with no tenth, three held changes plus scrape and pale line and held inch, nine record-first hands with the ninth on its own tray and the strip unread, covered grain unfigured, five askings with no witness. Hand answer one hundred: one rhythm carried across the little silence after a count that ended in the room that does not touch, taken as an object in its own right, crossing no second count and filling nothing to make a row come out even, down on the river's next low note. An object among objects, not a hearing, a seventh, a payment or a rule.

scenes.title: The Last Day of the Week
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry, fifth dated \daymark: Day 263, Smoke 24, Fourthday, Y.H. 813, the small hours under the Vail roof, then the ordinary morning at the hearth, the drying racks, the rack end, the loaf shelf, the boards and the yard well. New day, new date, no recap: 263 exact, six months and eighty-three days, nobody told (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and sixty-three days, its payer unnamed (T088); the widow's mark hanging where it hangs, untouched at a shelf, well, rack, road, basket, yard, afternoon and dusk (T058/T079). Smoke 30 (Day 269), the third and last Account-day of the second firing, stands six mornings ahead and is not brought early; the first firing of Frost (Day 271) is far off and unbrought; no market, Cross or bell. The third working week goes out as it came in, an ordinary tending that has learned nothing from the second reading, and the nothing learned is kept as a finding with no payer (T077, T071/T072). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells it the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it, counts under her breath toward no opening, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, moves her lips along the two-gapped row without a figure, sets the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat at the setting and no look toward the bed, glances once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing (T100). The dressed grain is turned under wool for damp and laid back on the cool stone at the rack end, changed in state and given no figure; the arithmetic to be read over it on Smoke 30 will not know its cost, and the space between the figure and its price stays unsigned (T077). Frost has gone out of the well lip under the bucket and the yard calls it weather; a wrong wind off High Kiln brings the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards, touches the fold and goes out on the wind that brought it, a direction arrived nowhere and not a second edge paid (T083/T085, T064). Costs asked at the door and the well go to the pot and the weather; a fist comes up toward the well and goes back into a sleeve (T015/T041/T047, T077). At the kindling the knife is at the lip with six where the house can check and the seventh where it cannot, Six counted. The next I don't count, the ninth stopping remembered and not a tenth, the loan uncalled, the seed-breath unspent (T036/T076); at the wheel-shed Jorra's grey dust and his finger in the damper go as before and the men are given no name (T035/T031, T062). Hand answer one hundred and one: up an inch toward the river's note, held for the small intake only, down on the river's next low note and not on the kiln's gap, keeping the three counts in three places that do not become one. An object on the sixth place.

scenes.title: The Hundred and Second Object
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 263, Smoke 24, Fourthday, afternoon into the small hours at the Clay Yard, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the back room as a direction and a sound, the clay road at the going of the light, the bed and the towel. Smoke goes on without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two names for the months is set right or left wrong. Afternoon thins without ending; heat into the fold; one leathery brown-edged crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint; afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform (T061/T082). Garl is kept in objects, name unspoken two hundred and sixty-three days, the tile debt neither paid nor settled nor done with, no collector up or down the clay road on Smoke 22, 23 or 24 (T009/T013/T092). The seven walked-around places are gone around with a look and a wide step and no number, including the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out (T098 carried). Sella carries him up at the going of the light at the half-pace from every open slate, goes wide around the seven places, sets him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face, leaves the thread frozen, tells the fire the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it, counts under her breath toward no opening and goes to her own bed; the widow's mark hangs where it hangs and the one opening before Smoke 1 stays behind the household with no lesson, no mending, no sign and no payer named, the next real opening being the first firing of Frost far off (T058/T079). At the kindling Tarn brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops, a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled, the stone cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006); at the wheel-shed edge Jorra's dust, his bent finger in the damper, the burned slate at four, the two shut-room tellings at two, the three pot sayings with the premature note apart and no fourth likeness, the promise ungiven and he's not Vail sealed (T035/T031, T062, T065/T095, T061/T082). In the small hours he turns the file out on the towel and finds the whole of it exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air: six hearings beside and never among with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place; three near-full answers; three pot sayings with the premature note on its own place; four low things with water over water a fifth; told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid with Smoke's second arithmetic gone up the road in a locked box and unread under this roof; nine stoppings with no tenth; three held changes plus the loft scrape and the pale line on five places and the held inch on a sixth; nine record-first hands with Ilva's ninth on its own tray and her stick unread in her sleeve, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth; the covered grain unfigured; the pan's gone ring and the shelf's two gaps and the fold's one crust with its gap on trays that do not touch; the ownerless question at five askings with no witness and no row named; and the house's not-doings kept beside his own kept gaps with a finger between, no joining and no payer (T071/T072, T080, T101, T060/T086, T100). Hand answer one hundred and two: the hand goes up an inch toward the river's low note, holds for the small intake, and comes down on the river's next low note; the little silence after the count that ended in the room that does not touch is kept empty on its own place this time, with no rhythm carried across it and nothing supplied to make a stroke in a row that had none — an empty object laid beside the held one and apart from it, a keeping and not a miss, not a longer reach, a hearing, a seventh, a stopping, a payment, a held change, a key, a power or a rule. Two hundred and sixty-three stands exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill or Grath; six months and eighty-three days are told by nobody; the carried fire stops at four with its fifth unpaid two hundred and sixty-three days and its payer unnamed; the count goes forward into Smoke 25, a day that has not earned its heading, and the file lies open with every tray parted and every gap left gap.
